# KRN-003: Network sysctls match the hardening baseline

- **Group:** Kernel settings
- **Severity when it fails:** low
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

ICMP redirects, source routed packets and broadcast ICMP are not needed on a server and help an attacker on the network path. SYN cookies and martian logging help against floods and spoofing. ufw also reapplies /etc/ufw/sysctl.conf when it is enabled or reloaded, which can undo a drop-in.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sysctl -a 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'accept_redirects|send_redirects|accept_source_route|tcp_syncookies|log_martians|echo_ignore_broadcasts'; cat /etc/ufw/sysctl.conf
```

## How to fix it

Set the values in a /etc/sysctl.d drop-in and make /etc/ufw/sysctl.conf agree.

## What a fix can break

accept_redirects and send_redirects can matter on a host that acts as a router.

Run `stackward explain KRN-003` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
